facts.value: Grades are considered in the admission process, with some programs requiring higher grades than the university average. Good grades are important for admission to Barrett, The Honors College, although there is no minimum GPA requirement.
There is no specific number of colleges to apply to; it varies by student. It is recommended to apply to more than one college for options if not admitted to the preferred college.

Most students take the ACT or SAT in the spring of their junior year, summer after junior year, or fall of their senior year. It is also suggested to take the PSAT in October of junior year for consideration in National Merit and National Recognition Scholarship programs.
